scope: Implement strict canonical schema (schema_version=2) for development experiment evidence reports. Prevent combining metrics, configuration identity, and gate booleans from different candidates. This first Phase 0 slice provides the validator and CLI boundary; experiment-pipeline integration remains pending.
changed: vision/experiment_evidence.py (new) — strict frozen Pydantic models: ComparisonBinding, GatePolicy, Configuration, DetectionMetrics, GateResult, CandidateResult, ExperimentReport. load_experiment_report(path) rejects direct symlinks, symlinked parents, and non-files.
vision/cli.py (minimal edit) — added validate-experiment-evidence Typer command with lazy import.
tests/test_experiment_evidence.py (new) — positive and adversarial acceptance tests.

design: Frozen Pydantic models with extra='forbid' and allow_inf_nan=False.
Lowercase SHA-256 Hex type for all digest fields.
Shared ComparisonBinding with single-value preprocessing, postprocessing, contracts, dataset, hardware, and harness digests.
Configuration.configuration_id derived from canonical JSON of parameters + binding (excluding label); supplied IDs must match derived.
DetectionMetrics preserves signed map_drop = reference_map - candidate_map and rejects inconsistent supplied values.
DetectionMetrics verifies coverage and high-confidence/class counts against matched, lost, and added counts.
GatePolicy defines thresholds for mAP drop, coverage, score delta, class mismatches, high-confidence losses, and high-confidence additions without hard-coded project values.
GateResult with kind + passed; ExperimentReport recomputes every gate from candidate metrics + policy and rejects forged/mismatched booleans.
Report status PASS/FAIL derived from selected candidate only; PARTIAL_PASS rejected.
policy_digest must match policy.canonical digest; binding.policy_digest must match report policy_digest.
report_digest computed as SHA-256 of canonical report JSON (excluding the property itself).
tests: Configuration ID changes when parameters or every binding digest changes, but not when only label changes.
Selected ID must exist and candidate IDs must be unique.
Forged gate booleans rejected, including high-confidence additions.
Inconsistent map_drop, metric counts, policy digest, report status, nonfinite metrics or parameters, postprocess binding, extra fields, direct or parent symlinks, and schema_version=1 all rejected.
Valid report round-trips through JSON and the CLI command.

risks_open_items: Existing schema_version=1 evidence files remain unmigrated; they are legacy development records only and are not accepted by the new canonical validator.
No existing evidence has been migrated or repaired; rerun or artifact-backed migration is required for canonical evidence.
The canonical schema does not encode benchmark/latency metrics; it focuses on parity gates and configuration identity.
Acceptance thresholds are not changed; GatePolicy carries user-supplied thresholds only.
Full migration tooling (schema_version=1 → 2) is out of scope for this slice.
next: Plan artifact-backed migration or rerun for legacy evidence into schema_version=2 format.
Integrate canonical report generation into experiment pipelines for future runs.
worker_review: GLM produced the initial schema and CLI slice. Root rejected its first acceptance run (26 passed, 1 failed; Ruff issues), requested one bounded revision, stopped the worker when its patch retry would have violated the approved editing method, then completed and independently verified the corrections.
test_results: ROOT ACCEPTED — focused evidence tests: 50 passed; targeted core/optimization/capsule regressions: 99 passed; full suite: 598 passed, 3 skipped; Ruff check: clean; Ruff format check: all 66 checked files conform; all 9 legacy evidence JSON files parse cleanly and remain unmigrated.
